import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import scipy.sparse as sp
from sklearn.feature_extraction import FeatureHasher
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Paths
TRAIN_PATH = "./input/train.csv"
TEST_PATH = "./input/test.csv"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission/"
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
df_train = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
df_test = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)

# Identify features
target_col = "target"
id_col = "id"
cat_cols = ["f_27"]
num_cols = [c for c in df_train.columns if c not in [target_col, id_col] + cat_cols]

# Prepare high-cardinality categorical feature via hashing
print("Processing categorical features...")
hasher = FeatureHasher(n_features=500, input_type="string", dtype=np.float32)
X_train_hash = hasher.fit_transform(df_train["f_27"].values.astype(str))
X_test_hash = hasher.transform(df_test["f_27"].values.astype(str))

# Prepare numerical features
X_train_num = df_train[num_cols].values.astype(np.float32)
X_test_num = df_test[num_cols].values.astype(np.float32)

# Convert numerical to sparse for efficient stacking
X_train_sparse = sp.hstack([X_train_hash, sp.csr_matrix(X_train_num)], format="csr")
X_test_sparse = sp.hstack([X_test_hash, sp.csr_matrix(X_test_num)], format="csr")

y_train = df_train[target_col].values

# Stratified train/validation split
print("Splitting data...")
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_sparse, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Calculate positive class weight to handle potential imbalance
pos_count = np.sum(y_tr == 1)
neg_count = np.sum(y_tr == 0)
scale_pos_weight = neg_count / max(pos_count, 1)

# LightGBM parameters
params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "num_leaves": 63,
    "max_depth": 8,
    "min_data_in_leaf": 31,
    "subsample": 0.8,
    "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
    "reg_alpha": 0.1,
    "reg_lambda": 0.1,
    "scale_pos_weight": scale_pos_weight,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
    "device_type": "cpu",
}

# Create datasets
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_tr, label=y_tr)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)

# Train model with early stopping
print("Training LightGBM model...")
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=1000,
    valid_sets=[val_data],
    callbacks=[
        lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False),
        lgb.log_evaluation(period=0),
    ],
)

# Evaluate on validation set
print("Evaluating on validation set...")
pred_val = model.predict(X_val)
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, pred_val)
print(f"Validation ROC-AUC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Predict on test set
print("Predicting on test set...")
pred_test = model.predict(X_test_sparse)

# Save submission
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({id_col: df_test[id_col].values, target_col: pred_test})
submission_path = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")
submission_df.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {submission_path}")
